title: What came between British Malaya and Federation of Malaya?
question: What came between British Malaya and Federation of Malaya?
claim: 2 documented links lead from British Malaya (1826) to Federation of Malaya (1948): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
